_comment: Declares exactly what constitutes 'the harness' for the purpose of
syncing this checkout to the shared Linux deployment path named in
docs/workflow/USAGE_MULTI_USER_SAFETY.md ('every harness update must sync to
/home/svcacct/AI/Agent'). Data, not scattered hardcoded logic -- same
pattern as dv_harness/context_budget.policy.json. Extend THIS file for a
include/exclude are resolved with pathlib glob semantics against the
project root. never_sync is a separate, stronger deny list: a file it
matches raises rather than being quietly skipped, because a credential
reaching a SHARED multi-user server is not a file to silently drop -- it
is a reason to refuse the whole sync and tell the operator why.

_never_sync_rationale.replay.ps1: CLAUDE.md's Remote Linux Execution amendment describes a local, never-committed credential script (replay.csh/replay.ps1) that supplies VCPW. It is real and present in this checkout's root, gitignored (.gitignore:11) and untracked. A root-level glob that reached it would ship one person's server password onto a SHARED multi-user deployment path.
_never_sync_rationale.settings.local.json: Per-user Claude Code settings, deliberately local; docs/workflow/USAGE_MULTI_USER_SAFETY.md's 'never share a --project-root' reasoning applies to per-user config the same way. The split follows the repo's OWN sharing decision rather than a guess: `git ls-files .claude/settings.json .claude/settings.local.json` shows settings.json tracked (shared, committed) and settings.local.json untracked (per-user), which is why one is included and the other is refused.
_never_sync_rationale.keys_and_pems: Standing rule from CLAUDE.md's Remote Control Mode section: never expose SSH private keys or credentials.

_exclude_rationale..dv-harness/**: Per-project RUNTIME state (state.json, events.jsonl, memory, blackboard, evidence DB). docs/workflow/USAGE_MULTI_USER_SAFETY.md's own rule is that each user needs their own --project-root; pushing one user's run state over the shared tree would overwrite everyone else's.
_exclude_rationale..work/**: Session scratch reports, not harness code.
_exclude_rationale.__pycache__: Build output; a stale .pyc on the server is worse than absent.
